title: Line of Business enum
description: The single definition of the LOB enum. Every document schema $refs this; it is never redeclared. Mirrors the Fideon SPEC_00 LOB enum (arch 0b).

lob_value.description: One coverage line. Infer it from the coverage described, the policy number prefix, or the form used - never from the carrier or the insured's industry. The first five are commercial lines; the rest are personal lines.

line_of_business.description: The coverage lines this document concerns, as a LIST (arch v2.1 0b). A certificate or a package policy routinely covers several lines, and a single-valued field forced the annotator to pick one and discard the rest - which taught the model to do the same. An EMPTY list means the document does not determine any line; it is not the same as an unlisted line, which goes in line_of_business_other. Do not guess.

line_of_business_other.description: Coverage lines the document names that are outside the supported enum - inland marine, cyber, crime, EPLI and so on. Also a list (v2.1 correction): a document can carry several unlisted lines. Recorded rather than dropped, because the count of what lands here is the evidence for whether the enum should grow.
